blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The August Twenty-One Movement (Atom) lashed out at President Marcos’ five-day visit to Singapore after it emerged that he might again watch a Formula 1 (F1) race in the island city-state. Malacañang earlier confirmed that, aside from attending a big gathering of potential investors, Marcos had been “invited” to the race by […]...
